decompose_logprices

Source: R/technicals.R
decompose_logprices.Rd

Seasonal and Trend decomposition using Loess (STL) decomposition of historical wholesale prices.
A log-type transformation $$y=\operatorname{arcsinh}(\frac{x}{scale})$$ This is referred to as the "logprice" and is close to a log transformation when x is larger than \(scale\). However, it crosses over to a linear function for small xand therefore handle negative wholesale prices smoothly.
The seasonal decomposition is in to periodic daily, weekly and aperiodic yearly terms. decompose_logprices() also fills any gaps in the input data to form an hourly time series.

The output of decompose_logprices() is the key input to generate_logprice_hmm() and to simulate_prices()

decompose_logprices(price_data)

Arguments

price_data

price data in format datetime,price e.g. sem_prices_2019_2025

Value

dataframe with STL decomposition of hourly price data

Examples

decompose_logprices(sem_prices_2019_2025)
